{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(df.head())
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.isnull().sum())
print(df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Check for formatting
print(df['status'].value_counts())
print(df['channel'].value_counts())
print(df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check if revenue is string with commas
print(f"Sample of revenue values: {df['revenue'].sample(5).values}")"}
